o: Brace yourselves... The future is about to get a whole lot stranger! It's a non-stop onslaught of swaggering space pirates, lab-grown meats, sexy scams... plus the shocking return of Dr. Zoidberg's lost love! You didn't see that coming, prior to being told about it just now!

eps.o: The Professor attempts to create lab-grown meat so Fry can compete in the world hotdog-eating championship.
Bender travels to Mississippi in search of a sexy scammer who ripped off his grandmother.
Bender and Fry are hired to deliver a priceless cargo, but they are attacked and pillaged by vicious space pirates.
The Planet Express ship crash-lands on a mysterious world inhabited by intelligent rats.
Amy's favorite pop star commands her massive army of fans using musical brain programming.
Hermes takes desperate measures to save his dying father, as Zoidberg reunites with an old flame.
Nibbler says goodbye after being chosen for a one-way mission to observe a dying universe.
The Planet Express crew sets sail on an epic ocean adventure.

eps.t: A New New York Yankee in King Elfo's Court
eps.o: A time-machine failure sends Fry sideways in time to a strangely familiar medieval land.
When Fry sneaks into a PG-13 movie as a kid, it results in shocking consequences a thousand years in the future.
